title: Common
description: Shared definitions used by every Drawlogic contract. Version 0.1.0. PRD v0.2.13 §7.5, App. A.

id.description: Stable identifier. Lower-case letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot.

hash.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the hashed document, hex, prefixed. See contracts/README.md for what each hash covers.

copy_key.description: Dotted path into contracts/copy.json. Code never hard-codes stamp, label or watermark text.

source.description: Provenance enum, PRD FR-40. Every model element carries one.

discipline.description: Stage 1 ships architecture only (Decision 1, OPEN). The list is the discipline packs named in PRD §5.

profile_ref.description: A pinned profile version, e.g. {id: gb-eng-residential, version: 1.3.0}.

profile_layer.description: Stack resolution order, FR-03: jurisdiction → regional amendment → client → office → manufacturer. Generic sits under the jurisdiction.

tier.description: Profile tier. 1 = signed by a named professional; 2 = drafted, partially signed. Null for Generic and for private office/client profiles, which carry no tier.

signer.description: A named professional with a declared credential (FR-62).

stack_entry.description: One profile in a drawing's active stack, as shown on the coverage statement and the stamp.

document_ref.description: A reference to a published standard. Profiles cite documents; they never republish them (PRD §3 non-goals).

source_detail.description: Where a value came from, beyond the enum. Which member is present depends on `source`.

profile.description: source: profile — the profile and version the default came from (FR-07).

manufacturer_profile.description: source: manufacturer — the signed product profile (FR-66, FR-162).

reference.description: source: reference — an upload, a DXF, geodata, or a precedent.

origin.description: Stated origin of an upload (FR-177), e.g. "my own work", "supplied by my client", "published elsewhere".

rights_confirmed.description: FR-177: user confirmed the right to use it for this purpose. An upload of someone else's work cannot be used until true.

attribution.description: FR-176: "[project], [designer]" for anything pinned from a precedent.

model.description: source: ai_inferred — the model that inferred it.

auto_fix.description: source: auto_fix — the rule whose deterministic fix set the value (FR-33).

geodata_provenance.description: FR-105. Imagery date and resolution, boundary source, elevation model and each layer's source.

provenance.description: Mixed into every model element. PRD §6 principle 4: an element with no source cannot exist.

verify.description: true on any ai_inferred element below the profile's verify threshold (default 0.8, FR-40).

length.description: A length in the drawing's units.

check_status.description: ✓ pass (verified, signed rule only) · ⚠ flag · — out of scope. Display symbols in copy.json → check.status_symbols.

blocked_value.description: An engineering value that is absent and will not be invented (FR-14, principle 6). Generation that would imply it is blocked.

request.description: The specific request shown to the user.

colour_ref.description: FR-160. Stored exactly as supplied; `value` is the colour converted from the code by a colour library, used for render conditioning and the ΔE2000 check.

library.description: Colour library and version used for the conversion.

material_basis.description: FR-163. What a rendered material is based on. Labels in copy.json → material_basis.
